data.name: Usage_TopLevel
data.value:
Usage: nodekit validate <recipe.json> [--strict-reproducible] nodekit render <recipe.json> --out <build-request.json> [--format build-request|raw-spec] [--pretty] [--strict-reproducible] nodekit submit <recipe.json> [--url <url>] [--receipt <path>] [--connect-timeout <seconds>] [--watch-timeout <duration>] [--format human|jsonl] [--strict-reproducible] nodekit recipe create [<recipe.json>] [--method ...] [--non-interactive ...] nodekit function-recipe create [<path>] --tool-spec-digest <digest> --base-tool-image-digest <digest> [--non-interactive --field Name=Value ...] nodekit function-recipe validate <path> nodekit function-recipe render <path> --out <out.json> [--pretty] nodekit function-recipe submit <path> [--url <url>] [--receipt <path>] [--connect-timeout <seconds>] [--watch-timeout <duration>] [--registration-timeout <seconds>] [--format human|jsonl] nodekit function-recipe register-replay <registration-receipt.json> [--url <url>] [--registration-timeout <seconds>] [--format human|jsonl] nodekit receipt watch|cancel <receipt.json>
Common option: --lang ko|en — language of on-screen messages (default ko; NODEKIT_LANG also works). JSONL, file contents and exit codes do not depend on the language. Run `nodekit <command> --help` for the options of each command (for example: nodekit submit --help).

data.name: Usage_RenderLine2
data.value: (Local preview only — no network calls. The default --format build-request is not an input to submit. raw-spec is identical to the raw_spec field value of the ToolSpecRequest that a real submit sends to ResolveToolSpec (other fields such as tool_name/version/requested_at are not included). By default raw-spec is single-line JSON identical to the real payload; add --pretty to read it more easily. Command/Inputs/Outputs/Display* fields exist only in the build-request preview and are not part of raw_spec — use nodekit function-recipe create for ports/commands. To actually submit, run nodekit submit <recipe.json>)

data.name: Receipt_Usage
data.value:
Usage: nodekit receipt watch <receipt.json> [--format human|jsonl] nodekit receipt cancel <receipt.json> [--format human|jsonl]
watch: observes the server build again using the saved build ID and records the final observation in the receipt. It does not submit again. It only receives and shows the server's observations from the start; it does not resume an earlier watch position or guarantee that each event is shown once. Ctrl-C stops only this watch; it does not cancel the server build. cancel: sends one server cancel request for the saved build ID. Use watch to check whether the server actually stopped. A receipt without a build ID (including submit_in_flight, where the submit result is unknown) sends no request and is not submitted again. --format jsonl: stdout carries only nodekit.receipt.v1 JSON records, one per line (the last is always completed). Diagnostics and follow-up commands go to stderr.
